name: Colonist
description: A common settler on this world. Work trade and survive.

name: Refugee
description: Destitute and displaced. Scavenge to survive.

name: Merchant
description: Buy low sell high across the Outer Rim.

name: Artisan
description: Craft goods and supply the colony economy.

name: Entertainer
description: Perform music and dance in cantinas across the galaxy.

name: Cantina Operator
description: Serve refreshments. The heart of any spaceport.

name: Doctor
description: Treat wounds and illness. A vital colony profession.

name: Arms Dealer
description: Legally trade weapons with the proper permits.

name: Stormtrooper
description: Enforce Imperial law. Protect and serve the Empire.

name: Imperial Officer
description: Command stormtroopers. Issue warrants and permits.

name: Planetary Governor
description: Lead the colony. Set laws taxes and lockdowns.

name: Rebel Soldier
description: Fight the Empire. Covert resistance operative.

name: Rebel Pilot
description: Fly sorties and support the Rebellion.
